name: Depth Compositing Speculated Intersections
definition: A kernel that iterates through N_Spec potential intersections for each active ray to select the closest one (if any) and writes it to the framebuffer, marking rays exiting without a hit as terminated.
summary: Depth Compositing Speculated Intersections selects the closest valid hit from multiple candidates per ray using offset buffers to resolve unique ray-block pairs in speculative ray traversal.
